name: clausebench
description: The clausebench vendor registry for Claude Code: who a vendor actually is, where its DPA is, and a sub-processor list built from the services your repository uses.

plugins.name: clausebench
plugins.description: Looks up a vendor's contracting legal entity, country, transfer mechanism and checked DPA link in the clausebench registry, and builds a sub-processor list from the services your repository uses. Sends the vendor names you ask about to clausebench.com; an optional local hook notices new dependencies.
